title: loading on button
rule: For a slow action, show loading on the button itself (spinner on the control that was pressed).

citation.source: NN/g — Button States: Communicate Interaction; Apple HIG — Buttons (activity indicator when the action does not complete instantly)

pass_when: A slow action shows a spinner/activity indicator on the pressed button itself.
fail_when: No loading on a slow action, or loading only elsewhere (page bar, toast) with none on the control.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
